Strange work finds its people

The marketplace for work too strange for the ordinary boards.

Part Etsy — handmade, one-of-one, made by a person. Part Fiverr — clear gigs, clear prices, start today. Part Uber — post the job and a verified maker is dispatched to it. All of it run like an atelier, not a warehouse: Enter → Post → Find → Make → Deliver → Grow.

Room 4 · Watch it grow

No commission on the bench yet

Hire any gig from the board — or book a Queso Hades offering — and it appears here on the bench, where you can walk it from first sketch to your doorstep. Nothing is charged until escrow, and escrow is released only when you approve.

Dominic · ConciergeThe house rules of makingMakers show work at every step. You can ask for one revision per step, free. Silence is never a status — if a step stalls, I knock on the workshop door myself.
Lumi · Flavor guideReading a work-in-progressEarly stages look rough on purpose — silhouette before sparkle. Judge the shape first; the finish arrives last, like frosting.
Pip · Gig spriteI carry the parcels!When a step completes I stamp the ticket. When delivery lands, I do a small lap of the hall. It is tradition.
Room 5 · Deliver & grow

Trust is the house style

Every payment rides escrow. Every maker carries an Aurosal mark — the house trust layer, checked across five dimensions before a single gig is listed.

01

Identity

A real person, verified — no anonymous workshops, no ghost sellers.

02

Provenance

The work’s history travels with it: who made it, from what, and when.

03

Context

Skills are vouched in the trades they were actually performed in.

04

Consent

References, likenesses and source material are used only with permission.

05

Continuity

Reviews and standing persist across every door of the house.

Grow a shop of your own
